clue.text: Declining money poor director hoards in retirement

indicators.note: retiring means going backwards, so the concealed run is read in reverse
hoards says the phrase holds the answer tucked inside it

parts.note: the letters run from the end of the first word through the second into the start of the third

explanation.surface: A broke film director keeps hold of his cash after stepping back from work, as his fortunes decline.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hoards' says the answer is held within 'money poor director', and 'in retirement' says it is read backwards there. 'Declining' is the definition, not part of the mechanism.
explanation.definitionFit: Something drooping is sagging or sinking, so a droopy plant is literally declining.

clue.text: Spontaneous type of note?

clue.text: Level dish supplied by a university

parts.note: a plate is a dish
